settings.heading:
Named ingredients.
Efficacious concentrations.
settings.text: We don't decorate labels. Every active below is here because of its mechanism, dose, and fit for Indian, acne-prone skin.

settings.heading: Name the percentage
settings.text: When a concentration matters, we show it — like 5% niacinamide or 2% salicylic acid — not vague enrichment language.

settings.heading: Cite the mechanism
settings.text: What pathway it supports, and what concern it is meant to address, in plain language.

settings.heading: Earn its place
settings.text: If an ingredient cannot explain its role in the formula, it does not belong on the label — or in the jar.

settings.heading: Inform the customer. Then sell.
settings.text: Playbook rule: name the percentage, cite the mechanism, make the consumer feel informed — never enriched-with fluff.

settings.heading: Actives with a reason
settings.text: Percentage. Mechanism. Which formulas use it. Literacy first — so you understand before you buy.

settings.heading: Words we use on purpose
settings.text: Short definitions for the biology behind the formulas — so mechanism language never feels like jargon for jargon’s sake.

settings.heading: Transparency
settings.text: We tell you exactly what's in it, why it's there, and what it is meant to do.

settings.heading: Efficacy
settings.text: Every ingredient earns its place at a concentration that actually works.

settings.heading: Indian-skin fit
settings.text: Climate, UV, oiliness and barrier stress shape which actives we choose — and how we deliver them.

settings.heading: Science you can verify.
settings.text: Ready to match actives to a routine? Start with the concern, then the product.
